segments.name: Commercial space
segments.description: Develops and sells satellites, satellite buses and components, plus space transportation, hosted payload and in-orbit servicing to government and commercial satellite operators.
segments.evidence: Momentus is a U.S. commercial space company that offers satellites, satellite buses, and other satellite components, transportation, communication, and infrastructure services, including hosted payloads and other in-orbit services.

revenueModel.text: Government and commercial satellite operators and space technology companies pay for satellites, satellite buses, hosted payloads, and last mile transportation of their payloads to custom orbits.
revenueModel.evidence: Government and commercial satellite operators and space technology companies and organizations are our principal customers and target customers.
